title: Space Infinite Shooter
subtitle: Infinite space exploration with dual-mode gameplay: strategic drift and combat arenas
challenge: Seamlessly blend infinite world generation with persistent resource management across two distinct gameplay modes. The challenge involved implementing floating-origin reset for coordinate overflow, efficient chunk pooling to handle dynamic entity loading/unloading, and state persistence through scene transitions while maintaining high performance on diverse hardware.
architecture: MVC-based architecture with singleton game data, event-driven communication via EventHub, and object pooling for projectiles and environmental entities. Grid-based chunk spawning (50x50) with floating origin reset enables true infinite world generation; dual gameplay loops (Drift Mode for exploration, Strike Mode for arena combat) use separate managers that share persistent resource state.
